description: Discover Keyword Planner ideas from up to 20 seed keywords, a URL, keywords plus URL, or a whole site. Returns historical volume, monthly trends, computed 3-month/YoY changes, competition, bids, close variants, optional concepts, and pagination. Read-only; no plan is saved.

customerId.description: Google Ads serving customer ID; use the client account, not its MCC manager

endYearMonth.description: Last year and month of the historical metrics period.

geoTargetIds.description: Google Ads geo-target constant IDs for the intended locations.

historyMonths.description: 13 months is enough to compute latest-month YoY while limiting response size

includeAdultKeywords.description: Allow adult keyword ideas where supported by the provider and the selected market.

includeAverageCpc.description: Request average cost-per-click metrics when available.

includeDeviceBreakdown.description: Include device-specific planning metrics when supported.

includeKeywordConcepts.description: Include Google's keyword concept grouping metadata.

languageId.description: Google Ads language constant ID for the keyword request.

network.description: Google Ads search network selector used for planning.

pageSize.description: Google supports up to 10,000; keep pages small for interactive MCP use and use larger pages only for controlled exports

pageToken.description: nextPageToken from a prior identical request

seedKeywords.description: Seed keyword phrases from which Google generates keyword ideas.

startYearMonth.description: First year and month of the historical metrics period.

url.description: Specific page URL to crawl; combine with seedKeywords if desired

name: google_ads_generate_keyword_ideas

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

title: google ads generate keyword ideas
